title: PAN
text:
[ 21. Representative Assessee Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#21)
In Part E, if Representative Assessee (RA) details are provided, it is mandatory to provide details of RA having Indian address (except for FPIs & minors). FPIs & minor can provide foreign address. [ 22. Contact Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#22)
Mobile Number and Email address of Representative Assessee are mandatory
[ 23. Address for Communication ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#23)
Applicant to select one of the options as applicable for dispatch of PAN card.
